kling 4.0.why: First and last frame plus up to 8 keyframes, 10 reference images and 5 videos, native stereo audio with lip sync, up to 30 s per job; strongest control in the catalog, mid price (Kie cheaper than APIMart's $0.157/s).

Vidu Q4.why: First frame or 15 reference images with voice references, synchronized dialogue and effects, up to 16 s, 4K; no last frame, so not for chained launch shots. Kie is cheaper than APIMart ($0.0912/s at 720p).

HappyHorse-1.1.why: Character consistency from up to 9 references, first frame, 15 s at 1080p; no last frame and no sound, so silent hero shots, not chained launch joins.

HappyHorse-1.0.why: Ranked first for no-audio text and image to video on Artificial Analysis per the page; strong physics and motion stability, plus video edit. First frame only; APIMart sells it at $0.13/s at 720p.

gemini-omni-video.why: The first Gemini Omni Flash, sold per video; Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash adds first and last frame control at a lower price, so it replaces this one.

google/gemini-omni-flash-1-1.why: First and last frame, 7 references, a reference video for scene extension, character IDs, 360p drafts; $0.42 for 6 s at up to 1080p on Kie, cheaper per second than APIMart ($0.088/s at 720p).

kling 2.6.why: Kie sells only text and first-frame modes; APIMart sells the same model with a first and last frame (pro) at $0.0625/s, so the APIMart route replaces this one.

kling 2.5 turbo.why: First and tail frame at 1080p for $0.42 per 10 s, strong prompt adherence and physics; its audio can't be turned off (a silent launch film mutes it).

Kling 2.1.why: Older generation; Kling 2.5 Turbo does first and last frame at 1080p for less with better adherence.

hailuo 2.3.why: Cheap image to video ($0.15 for 6 s at 768p) with facial micro-expressions and anime, illustration and watercolor styles; first frame only, no sound.

hailuo 02.why: First and last frame at $0.025/s (768p), $0.01/s at 512p: the cheapest chained-shot option, good for motion tests and drafts; older quality.

wan 2.7 video.why: First and last frame with a 9-grid input, driving audio for lip sync, reference to video with voice timbre, and video edit; APIMart sells it at about $0.066/s at 720p.

wan 2.6.why: Native audio with lip sync, multi-shot storytelling, 15 s; no last frame. APIMart is cheaper ($0.05/s).

wan 2.6 flash.why: Fast and cheap image or reference to video ($0.02/s at 720p silent, $0.04 with audio), multi-shot option; APIMart's i2v flash is cheaper still ($0.0168/s).

wan 2.5.why: Superseded by Wan 2.6 and 2.7 (longer, last frame, references) at similar prices; 800-character prompt limit.

Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API image to Video.family: Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API image to Video
Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API image to Video.why: 720p maximum, no sound, no last frame; newer Wan models do more for the same or less.

Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API text to Video.family: Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API text to Video
Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API text to Video.why: Text only, 720p maximum, no sound; every production starts from drawn frames, which this can't take.

Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API Speech to Video.family: Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API Speech to Video
Wan 2.2 A14B Turbo API Speech to Video.why: About 5 s per job at $0.12/s; Kling AI Avatar and OmniHuman 2.0 lip-sync minutes of audio for less.

wan 2.2 Animate.why: Drives a character image with a reference video's motion, or replaces the person in a video, up to 30 s; useful for clone-me and dance or demo templates.

bytedance/seedance-v1-lite.why: First Seedance generation; Seedance 2.0 Mini (already run by the engine) and Seedance 1.5 Pro on APIMart beat it.

bytedance/seedance-v1-pro.why: Superseded by Seedance 1.5 Pro on APIMart (first and last frame plus audio at $0.044/s) and the Seedance 2 family.

bytedance/seedance-v1-pro-fast.why: Image to video only, first generation; Seedance 2.0 Fast replaces it.

Runway.why: Gen-4 Turbo at $0.06 per 720p video (about $0.012/s), coherent cinematic motion and extend; no last frame or sound, so silent single shots and drafts.

kling 2.6 motion control.why: Moves a character image with a reference video's full-body motion and hand gestures, up to 30 s; for spokespeople, demos and AI influencers.

omnihuman-2-0.why: Talking avatar from one image and up to 5 min of audio, with gestures and multi-person scenes, $0.07/s at 720p.

omnihuman-1-5.why: 1080p talking portrait with emotion-aware gestures, also anime and pets; best under 15 s, twice OmniHuman 2.0's price.

Kling AI Avatar.why: Long talking avatars (5 min) with speech and singing, realistic or illustrated, $0.04/s at 720p, $0.08/s at 1080p 48 fps: the cheapest long-form avatar.

MeiGen-AI InfiniteTalk.why: Lip-synced talking portrait from one image, $0.015/s at 480p for drafts, 15 s per job.

volcengine.why: Re-lip-syncs an existing video to new audio (dubbing a filmed take), up to 4 min, $0.04/s; single speaker.

APIMart: Kling V4 Video Generation.why: Same Kling 4.0 as on Kie (keyframes, references, stereo audio, 30 s, edit and extend); APIMart costs more ($0.157/s vs $0.1425/s at 720p), so it is the fallback route.

APIMart: Vidu Q4 Preview Video Generatio.family: APIMart: Vidu Q4 Preview Video Generation
APIMart: Vidu Q4 Preview Video Generatio.why: Vidu Q4 (first frame or 15 references, audio, 16 s); Kie sells it cheaper.

APIMart: FLUX 3 Video Generation.why: Start, end and up to 8 evenly spaced middle frames, synced audio that can be turned off, 20 s, and a draft mode at about a third of the price ($0.048/s): fits chained shots and cheap motion tests.

APIMart: SkyReels V4 Video Generation.why: First, end and 6 middle keyframes plus subject references and voice-driven lip sync, 15 s, $0.088/s at 720p (fast); no sound output.

APIMart: PixVerse V6 Max Video Generatio.family: APIMart: PixVerse V6 Max Video Generation
APIMart: PixVerse V6 Max Video Generatio.why: PixVerse's higher tier, $0.039/s at 720p, optional audio; text or one image only (no last frame, no references), so single shots.

APIMart: Pixverse v6 Video Generation.why: The PixVerse v6 the engine runs on Kie, cheaper here ($0.032/s vs $0.036/s at 720p); its first and last frame transition takes only 5 or 8 s.

APIMart: Kling v3 Omni Video Generation.family: APIMart: Kling v3 Omni Video Generation
APIMart: Kling v3 Omni Video Generation.why: First and last frame, up to 3 subjects with 2–4 images each, a reference or base video, up to 6 shots per job and audio, $0.067/s at 720p.

APIMart: Kling 3.0 Turbo Video Generatio.why: First frame only at $0.114/s; Kling v3 Omni does first and last frame with references for less.

APIMart: Kling Video O1 Video Generation.family: APIMart: Kling Video O1 Video Generation
APIMart: Kling Video O1 Video Generation.why: Start and end frames, references and a base video to edit, $0.067/s at 720p; 5 or 10 s only.

APIMart: Kling 2.6 Video Generation.why: First and last frame at 1080p (pro) for $0.0625/s; audio in pro, but not together with a last frame; 5 or 10 s.

APIMart: Kling v2.6 Motion Control Video.family: APIMart: Kling v2.6 Motion Control Video Generation
APIMart: Kling v2.6 Motion Control Video.why: Motion transfer from a reference video onto a character image (v2.6 at $0.057/s, v3 at $0.103/s), up to 30 s.

APIMart: Vidu Q3(pro/turbo) Video Genera.why: First and last frame with audio up to 16 s; Turbo $0.048/s at 720p, Pro $0.12/s.

APIMart: Vidu Q3(mix/standard) Reference.why: Up to 7 reference images keep one character across shots, 16 s, $0.08/s at 720p; no frame control.

APIMart: Grok Official Video Models.why: The official Grok Imagine endpoints cost more than the Grok Imagine 1.5 route the engine already runs, with no frame control.

APIMart: MiniMax-H3-Max Video Generation.why: H3's higher tier: first and last frame or multimodal references, 1080p, $0.057/s at 768p; the engine runs plain H3 only.

APIMart: MiniMax-H3 Video Generation.why: The MiniMax H3 the engine already runs through Kie, where 768p costs $0.04/s against $0.057/s here.

APIMart: MiniMax-H3 Regeneration.why: Re-renders a finished H3 768p take at 2K; a finishing step, not a generator (deliveries are 720p).

APIMart: MiniMax-H3 Context-IR Prompt En.why: Returns an enhanced text prompt and no video; the engine writes its own granular prompts.

APIMart: MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3 Video Genera.why: Hailuo 2.3 Fast at $0.025/s (768p), Standard $0.049/s: cheap expressive image to video with camera commands; first frame only.

APIMart: MiniMax-Hailuo-02 Video Generat.why: First and last frame from $0.0104/s at 512p: the cheapest chained motion test; Kie sells 768p cheaper.

APIMart: HappyHorse 1.1 Video Generation.why: HappyHorse 1.1 (first frame or 9 references, 15 s); Kie is cheaper ($0.1125/s at 720p).

APIMart: HappyHorse 1.0 Video Generation.why: HappyHorse 1.0 with video edit, $0.13/s at 720p here against $0.14/s on Kie.

APIMart: Wan2.7 Video Generation.why: Wan 2.7 first and last frame, continuation and driving audio, 15 s, cheaper here ($0.066/s) than on Kie ($0.08/s).

APIMart: Wan2.7-R2V Reference-to-Video.why: Characters from reference images or videos, each with its own reference voice, 15 s, $0.066/s.

APIMart: Wan2.7-VideoEdit Video Editing.why: Edits or restyles existing footage; not a generator for a production's shots.

APIMart: Wan2.6 Video Generation.why: Wan 2.6 with generated or supplied audio, 15 s, $0.05/s at 720p (cheaper than Kie).

APIMart: wan2.6-i2v-flash Image-to-Video.why: The cheapest image to video in the catalog ($0.0168/s at 720p silent, $0.034 with audio), multi-shot option.

APIMart: wan2.5-preview Video Generation.why: Audio can't be turned off and Wan 2.6 and 2.7 replace it at lower or equal prices.

APIMart: gemini-omni-1.1-flash-ext Video.why: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with reference fusion and a reference video, $0.30 per job (about $0.05/s for 6 s); no last frame.

APIMart: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Gen.family: APIMart: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Generation
APIMart: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Gen.why: First and last frame, references, edit and extension with audio; the model picks the length (3–10 s), which a timed plan has to allow for. Kie sells it cheaper per job.

APIMart: Gemini Omni Flash Video Generat.family: APIMart: Gemini Omni Flash Video Generation
APIMart: Gemini Omni Flash Video Generat.why: The preview Omni Flash, 720p only; Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash replaces it at the same price.

APIMart: VEO3 Official Video Generation.why: Veo 3.1 Fast and Quality through Google's official route, billed per second: Fast $0.064/s at 720p ($0.08 with audio), Quality $0.16/s, first and last frame, 4/6/8 s.

APIMart: VEO3 Video Remix.why: Extends a finished 8 s Veo take to 15 s; an extension step, not a generator.

APIMart: seedance-1-5-pro Video Generati.why: First and last frame with audio up to 12 s, $0.044/s at 720p ($0.02 at 480p).

APIMart: seedance-1-0-pro Video Generati.why: Seedance 1.5 Pro adds audio at the same price as 1.0 Pro Quality; the 1.0 Fast tier can't take a first and last frame together.

APIMart: Virtual Avatar Assets.why: Registers approved avatar assets for Seedance 2.0; it makes no video by itself.
